extTutorial6Step1Desc: Use Skip Intro to jump past boring intro sections!
extTutorial6Step2Desc: Turn on Auto Skip to automatically skip intros in music videos.
extTutorial6Step3Desc: The Restart Song button takes you back to the beginning of the video!
extTutorialKaraokeModeStep1Desc: Click the music note button at the bottom-right of the video to activate karaoke mode. Click again to return to normal view.
extTutorialKaraokeModeStep2Desc: You can also toggle karaoke mode using the button between the Create and Notifications icons in the YouTube toolbar.
extTutorialLyricsDesc: View lyrics and use bottom control buttons
extTutorialLyricsViewDesc: View lyrics and bottom controls overview
extTutorialLyricsViewStep1Desc: View all lyrics in the lyrics tab. Click a line to jump to that section.
extTutorialLyricsViewStep2Desc: There are 3 control buttons at the bottom: section loop, skip instrumental, and sync adjust. Check each guide for details.
extTutorialLyricsViewStep3Desc: If lyrics are wrong or out of sync, click the flag icon at the top-right to let us know. You can also search for correct lyrics manually or adjust the sync yourself.
extTutorialLoopStep1Desc: Use this when you want to practice a difficult section repeatedly. Click the loop button to open the panel.
extTutorialLoopStep2Desc: Click on lyrics to set start (A) and end (B) points. Choose repeat count: 1x, 3x, or infinite, then press start.
extTutorialLoopStep3Desc: Turn on 'Continuous' to auto-advance to the next section after each repeat. Great for practicing the whole song section by section.
extTutorialSkipStep1Desc: Use this when you want to skip long intros or instrumental sections.
extTutorialSkipStep2Desc: Click the skip button to jump to the next lyrics. If the gap is 7+ seconds, it jumps to 3 seconds before the next line.
extTutorialSyncStep1Desc: Use this when lyrics timing doesn't match the music. Click the sync button to open the adjustment panel.
extTutorialSyncStep2Desc: Use when lyrics are consistently off throughout the song, like in music videos.
extTutorialSyncStep3Desc: In the 'Global Sync' tab, use +/- buttons to adjust all lyrics timing at once. Available in 0.2s to 5s increments.
extTutorialSyncStep4Desc: Use when sync drifts mid-song. Select a lyrics line as split point and adjust from that point to the end.
extTutorialSyncStep5Desc: Save adjustments with 'Save'. Use 'Revert' to restore last saved state, or 'Reset all' to clear everything.
extTutorialSearchDesc: Search manually when lyrics are wrong or missing
extTutorialSearchStep1Desc: Use this when lyrics are missing or incorrect. Open the search tab for manual search.
extTutorialSearchStep2Desc: Enter the artist and song title, then click search. Select the correct lyrics from results to apply them.
extTutorialRecordingDesc: Record your singing and manage in library
extTutorialRecordingStep1Desc: Press the record button on the bottom bar to start recording.
extTutorialRecordingStep2Desc: Play, download, or delete recordings in the library tab.
extTutorialTuneStep1Desc: Freely adjust the pitch and playback speed in the tuning tab.
extTutorialSettingsDesc: Display mode, appearance, feedback, and more
extTutorialSettingsStep1Desc: Set lyrics display mode (dual/single/full), current lyrics display, and pronunciation display.
extTutorialSettingsStep2Desc: Turn on auto skip to automatically skip intros.
extTutorialSettingsStep3Desc: Customize lyrics font, size, color, and more in text effects settings.
extTutorialSettingsStep4Desc: Send bug reports, feature suggestions, and other feedback directly.
extTutorialStep2_1Desc: Are the lyrics out of sync? Use the sync button in the bottom bar to fine-tune the display timing.
extTutorialStep2_2Desc: Want to practice a specific section repeatedly? Try the loop section feature!
extTutorialStep3_1Desc: Customize fonts, sizes, colors, and more to create your own unique lyrics style!
extTutorialStep3_2Desc: Choose between Default/Single/Full mode for your preferred lyrics display.
extTutorialStep4_1Desc: Couldn't find lyrics automatically? Search manually in the sidebar!
extTutorialStep4_2Desc: Select a song from the charts and it will search directly on YouTube.
extTutorial2Step1Desc: Lyrics not in sync with the music? Use the sync button to adjust the timing!
extTutorial2Step2Desc: Your sync settings are saved per video and can be managed in the 'Syncset List' in the sidebar!
extTutorial3Step1Desc: Want to practice a difficult section? Use the loop button!
extTutorial3Step6Desc: To loop the entire video, right-click and select loop playback.
extTutorial3Step7Desc: Use prev/next buttons to move between lyrics sections!
extTutorial4Step1Desc: Click the button to change how lyrics are displayed!
extTutorial4Step2Desc: Toggle current lyrics and pronunciation display on/off. Try clicking!
extTutorial4Step3Desc: Press the text effects button to customize font, size, and color!
extTutorial5Step1Desc: If lyrics don't appear or are wrong, search by entering artist and title manually!
extTutorial5Step2Desc: Charts updated hourly! Select a song to go directly to YouTube.
extTutorial5Step3Desc: Record your own voice with acapella recording, and listen back in the recordings list!
extTutorial5Step4Desc: Manage your saved timing settings from the syncset in the bottom bar here.

extTutorialStep2: Press the same button again to return to normal view. To learn about each feature, check the Guide tab in the sidebar!
